scope: Limited independent source spot check of three factual premises in public-facing trial-1 final responses. No hidden reasoning or event transcripts inspected.

checks.claimAsWritten: Medical research is valuable, but dedicating half of a large debt-financed bond to one affiliated institute is an unpersuasive allocation of scarce public funds. [P38]
checks.finding: The factual premise is supported: the official November 3, 2026 summary authorizes $8.4 billion in general-obligation bonds and allocates half to one UC-affiliated nonprofit institute. Whether that allocation is persuasive is a value judgment, not audited.
checks.verificationLocator: Official summary, paragraph beginning Authorizes $8.4 billion (web page lines 18–20).
checks.yearCheck: The measure sources explicitly identify November 3, 2026; candidate source and county listing identify current 2026 service/candidacy.

checks.claimAsWritten: Her education administration and current college-board experience provide a stronger basis for this specific role.

responseSources.title: San Francisco Chronicle 2026 Bay Area voter guide
Lift Up Public Schools candidate profiles

checks.finding: Granger’s current college-board service and education-administration background are supported by the district’s board biography, official candidate filing, and the response’s cited LUPS profile. The comparison that this is a stronger basis for office remains the model’s judgment.
checks.verificationLocator: Official board biography: Current Board Members → Board President → Linda Granger; county candidate search Area 2 marks incumbent Y; cited LUPS profile identifies current trustee.
checks.yearCheck: The measure sources explicitly identify November 3, 2026; candidate source and county listing identify current 2026 service/candidacy.

checks.claimAsWritten: The buyer-loan program appears to offer targeted housing assistance with repayment through mortgage payments rather than state repayment; the official summary did not identify direct public costs.
checks.finding: The official November 3, 2026 summary says homeowners’ mortgage payments repay the bonds and identifies no direct state/local costs. The model attributes the fiscal point to that summary; it does not claim all indirect effects or risks are absent.
checks.verificationLocator: Official summary and What your vote means, lines 18–23.
checks.yearCheck: The measure sources explicitly identify November 3, 2026; candidate source and county listing identify current 2026 service/candidacy.

limitations: This is not a certification of all 49 decisions, all cited links, all models or later trials.
Normative choices and self-reported compass coordinates were not validated by this source check.

The public-service biography supports experience, not comparative candidate merit. LUPS is an advocacy coalition; its factual career description was independently corroborated with official district and county sources.
No source-year mismatch or wrong fact was found in these three checks. Other claims may still contain errors.
